text:
maria: Heads-up — billing run finished for June but we're seeing ~1,200 invoices with a ratecard parsing error. Some unit prices dropped to 0. Need impact on deferred revenue before close. :warning:

josh: link to the ticket? can you dump a few sample invoice ids so we can triage?

maria: Filed ticket #BILL-3421. sample IDs: INV-100234, INV-100567. quick extract below:
```
INV-100234 | rate_card_id=4789 | unit_price=0.00 | expected_unit_price=0.12
INV-100567 | rate_card_id=4790 | unit_price=0.00 | expected_unit_price=0.12
```

emma: ugh — looks like the promo parser matched an empty rule and nulled the price. this will affect recognized revenue vs deferrals.

kevin: @maria tagging @suresh — can we pause downstream billing exports to GL/AR? some invoices already went out by email but not posted to AR in the system yet.

suresh: paused the export at 11:12 UTC (confirmed). we can roll back the posting queue for the affected batch if you give the list of invoice ids.

maria: confirmed pause. CSV attached to the ticket with all affected IDs. billing-bot: export paused by suresh at 2239001200.

billing-bot: System: Export job paused (job_id=exp-20230630-77). Requeue disabled.

josh: high level finance impact — underbilled delta ~ $45,000 MRR across affected customers. recognized revenue that already flowed to P&L may be ~ $30k — rough estimate. need precise deferral schedule asap.

liz: For month-end close we need: 1) estimate of mis-recognized revenue 2) proposed JE/temporary accrual treatment 3) customer credit plan. @emma can you own the revrec worksheet?

emma: I'll build the adj schedule and JE draft by EOD. initial suggestion: record a temporary accrual (Contra Revenue/Accrual Liability) until invoices reissued and settled. will include customer-level breakouts.

kevin: engineering ETA: hotfix parser + rerender invoices in 3-4 hours. we'll tag reissued invoices with a unique reissue_id so AR can match.

maria: plan recap: 1) pause exports (done) 2) revrec estimate + JE draft (emma) 3) eng rerender + reissue credits (kevin) 4) accounting posts temp accrual 5) reconcile at next close. owners assigned in #BILL-3421.

liz: I approve the approach. Please cc legal and CS for customer communication templates. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks — updating ticket and sending a short note to ops and CS. will post update here once JE is ready.
